items.title: The derived tensor product of bounded above complexes with locally constant finite type cohomology has locally constant finite type cohomology
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that over a site with a Noetherian ring Lambda, if K and L are bounded above complexes of Lambda-modules whose cohomology sheaves are locally constant of finite type, then the cohomology sheaves of the derived tensor product K tensor^L L are again locally constant of finite type (statement lines 14355-14363). The proof (proof lines 14365-14376) makes three reductions: to bounded complexes by truncation, to complexes of locally constant finite type sheaves by the representation lemma, and to complexes of finite free modules where the claim is immediate. H2: a three-step reduction with two inputs, written out in full.
